text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition on the east side of Huntley Street, between Selby Street and Bloor Street East, be increased to a standing prohibition. The proposed amendment will further deter parking on this section of roadway which will improve unobstructed two-way traffic flow and provide a safer environment for all road users.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Huntley Street, between Selby Street and Bloor Street East. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the east side of Huntley Street, between Selby Street and Bloor Street East.
